name: Cinderbrand
text: Melee attacks also send a wave of fire forward for {wave} weapon damage.

name: Trident of Embers
text: Pierce skills throw {count} extra projectiles in a fan.

name: Gauntlets of the Tide
text: Pierce projectiles fly back to you at the end of their path, hitting again.

name: Grip of the Reaper
text: Every 3rd melee attack hits all around you for {ringMult}× damage.

name: Pyre Mail
text: Fire skills ignite enemies, burning for {igniteMult} of the hit over 3 seconds.

name: Heart of Ash
text: Enemies killed by fire skills explode for {explodeOnKill} of their max life.

name: Comet Treads
text: Dash skills leave a burning trail for 3 seconds.

name: Stride of Echoes
text: Dash skills have {charges} extra charges.

name: Brood Crown
text: Summon skills call {count} extra minions.

name: Hollow Diadem
text: Your minions explode for {burst} weapon damage when they expire.

name: Bulwark of Cinders
text: Shouts also blast enemies in their radius for {shoutDamage} weapon damage.

name: Pauldrons of the Pack
text: Minions last twice as long.

name: Frostgrip Bracers
text: Cold skills slow {slowPct}% more and slowed enemies take 20% more damage from you.

name: Girdle of Momentum
text: Dashing resets the cooldown of your secondary skill.

name: Legplates of the Nova
text: Area skills pulse {pulses} extra times.

name: Eye of the Rift
text: Projectile skills fire {count} extra projectile and fly 40% faster.

name: Band of Echoing Cries
text: Shout skills have half the cooldown.

name: Ember Loop
text: Fire skills make enemies take {vulnOnHit}% more damage for 3 seconds.

name: Ashen Vow
text: Your generators build 60% more resource.

name: Hunter's Patience
text: Killing an enemy with a skill that costs resource refunds {refundOnKill} of its cost.

name: Cinder Heart
text: Taking damage gives you {resOnHurt} resource.

name: Conduit Rod
text: Lightning skills jump to {chain} more enemies.

name: Void Lens
text: Arcane skills cost 30% less resource.

name: Tempest Mantle
text: Area skills are 30% larger.

name: Foreman's Grips
text: Turrets and mortars fire {shots} extra shots.

name: Marrow Engine
text: Your constructs heal allies near them for 1% of max life per second.

name: Ossuary Blueprint
text: You can keep {maxCount} more of each construct.

name: Colossus Core
text: Colossus slams deal {slamDamage} more weapon damage and the Colossus lasts 4 seconds longer.

name: Sunwheel Gauntlets
text: Searing Strike hits all around you instead of one target in front.

name: Crown of Lances
text: Ember Lance throws {count} lances in a ring around you, each for 60% damage.

name: Ram's Bulwark
text: Shield Bash hits all around you and pulls enemies in instead of pushing them away.

name: Cinder Step
text: Ash Dash explodes where you land for {endBlast}× damage.

name: Raven Wheel
text: Volley fires in a full circle with {count} more arrows.

name: Boomerang Femur
text: Bone Shot flies back to you at the end of its path, hitting again.

name: Knife Storm Vest
text: Shadow Knives fan out all around you with {count} more knives.

name: Stormcoil
text: Spark fires {count} bolts in a ring around you, each for 60% damage.

name: Orbit Lens
text: Arcane Orb comes back to you at the end of its path, hitting again.

name: Halo of Missiles
text: Magic Missile fires all around you with {count} more missiles.

name: Rivet Wheel
text: Rivet Shot fires {count} rivets in a ring around you, each for 50% damage.

name: Whirling Mallet
text: Every Bone Mallet swing hits all around you.

name: Concord Band
text: Your sets need one fewer piece (you still need 2 of a set worn). Only the Ossuary King drops it.
